newsitem.title: USA: Board accepts CSX, Norfolk application.
newsitem.headline: Board accepts CSX, Norfolk application.

text.p: CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp Wednesday moved another step toward their proposed $10.3 billion purchase of Conrail Inc as a federal regulator formally accepted their application.
The Surface Transportation Board said it had accepted the railroad control application and related filings submitted to the board a month ago.
In a statement, the board also said it intended to follow its previously announced procedural schedule.

That means the next key dates are August 6, when comments on the draft scope of the environmental impact statement are due, and August 7, when parties who intend to particpate in the proceedings must notify the board.
A final decision on the split up of the East Coast railroad is not expected until June 8, 1998 under this timetable.

In a related move, the board also invited public comment on six connection tracks that the railroads have sought to begin work on despite the risk that they might be denied overall approval of their deal to carve up Conrail.
